newsitem.title: USA: Best Resources changes business focus.
newsitem.headline: Best Resources changes business focus.

text.p: Best Resources Inc said it restructured its business activities to focus on the selective development of commercial and residential real estate opportunities, and changed its name.
Formerly the company imported and distributed exotic fish. The company's new name is Diversified Concepts Inc and its new trading symbol on NASDAQ is DVCC, the company said.
